messages.author: Oke, Elizabeth Damilola
messages.body:
Hi all,
I've been encountering an issue with running GaMD with AMBER. I receive the error message 'Illegal memory access was encountered launching kernel kClearforces.'
The minimization runs perfectly. The error appears when running the equilibration. The timestep for heating is already at 0.001. I have also tried running on the CPU with Sander, but it still could not be resolved.
I would appreciate any information or leads that could help resolve this issue.
Thank you,
Elizabeth

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
On Thu, Jun 12, 2025 at 11:30 AM Oke, Elizabeth Damilola via AMBER
<amber.ambermd.org> wrote:
> I have also tried running on the CPU with Sander, but it still could not be resolved.
Can you expand on this a bit? Does sander fail with an error message?
Have you tried pmemd on the CPU as well?
-Dan
